// REQ: LANG-1451 LANG-1452
import QtQuick 2.15
import QtQuick.Controls 2.15

/* Main window */
Rectangle {
    id: root
    width: 640; height: 480
    color: "lightblue"
    property int count: 0x1F
    property string name: qsTr("world")
    signal clicked(int x)

    Text {
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        text: `Hello, ${root.name}!`
    }
    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: root.count++ }
}
